725	def _get_megatron_emerging_optimizer(
726	    config: OptimizerConfig,
727	    model_chunks: List[MegatronModule],
728	    config_overrides: Optional[Dict[ParamKey, Any]] = None,
729	    pg_collection: Optional[ProcessGroupCollection] = None,
730	) -> MegatronOptimizer:
731	    """Build an emerging optimizer (e.g. Muon) for the given model chunks.
732	
733	    Parameter separation (e.g., linear weights -> Muon, rest -> Adam) is expressed as a
734	    config_override, the same mechanism used for weight-decay and learning-rate overrides.
735	    Adam/SGD groups are delegated to _get_megatron_optimizer_based_on_param_groups so they
736	    go through the exact same code path as the standard optimizer factory.
737	
738	    When ``config.use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer`` is True, the underlying optimizers
739	    are wrapped with :class:`LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer`.
740	    """
741	    eopt_name = config.optimizer
742	    use_layer_wise = config.use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer
743	
744	    # Handle legacy "dist_*" optimizer names (e.g. "dist_muon" → "muon" + layer-wise).
745	    if eopt_name.startswith('dist_'):
746	        bare_name = eopt_name[len('dist_') :]
747	        warnings.warn(
748	            f"optimizer='{eopt_name}' is deprecated. "
749	            f"Use optimizer='{bare_name}' with use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True.",
750	            DeprecationWarning,
751	            stacklevel=3,
752	        )
753	        eopt_name = bare_name
754	        use_layer_wise = True
755	
756	    if isinstance(model_chunks[0], FullyShardedDataParallelV2):
757	        raise NotImplementedError("MFSDP v2 with emerging optimizers is not currently validated.")
758	
759	    if not HAVE_EMERGING_OPTIMIZERS:
760	        raise ImportError(
761	            f"emerging-optimizers package is required for optimizer='{eopt_name}'. "
762	            "Install it with: pip install emerging-optimizers"
763	        )
764	    assert not (use_layer_wise and config.overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step), (
765	        "overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step is not supported with "
766	        "use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer: the emerging-optimizer path does not "
767	        "split model_chunks into (first, rest) groups, so the per-chunk param-gather "
768	        "dispatch never fires. Disable one of the two flags."
769	    )
770	    if eopt_name not in _EMERGING_OPTIMIZERS:
771	        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported emerging optimizer: {eopt_name}")
772	    if config.fp16:
773	        raise ValueError('emerging optimizer with fp16 is not supported.')
774	
775	    if pg_collection is None:
776	        pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
777	
778	    log_single_rank(logger, logging.INFO, f'Setting up emerging optimizer with config {config}')
779	
780	    # Tag parameters with optimizer-specific attributes (expert_tp, is_qkv).
781	    for model_chunk in model_chunks:
782	        qkv_split_shapes = None
783	        for name, param in model_chunk.named_parameters():
784	            if not param.requires_grad:
785	                continue
786	            if 'experts' in name and 'shared' not in name:
787	                param.expert_tp = True
788	            # TODO(deyuf): support MLA
789	            if 'linear_qkv.weight' in name and len(param.shape) == 2:
790	                if qkv_split_shapes is None:
791	                    qkv_split_shapes = _get_qkv_split_shapes(model_chunk.config)
792	                if param.shape[0] % sum(qkv_split_shapes) == 0:
793	                    param.is_qkv = True
794	                    param.qkv_split_shapes = qkv_split_shapes
795	                else:
796	                    log_single_rank(
797	                        logger,
798	                        logging.DEBUG,
799	                        f"Emerging optimizer QKV split skipped for {name}: "
800	                        f"shape={tuple(param.shape)}, split_shapes={qkv_split_shapes}",
801	                    )
802	
803	    # Apply optimizer-specific default param overrides (e.g. muon: non-linear -> adam).
804	    # For Muon-family optimizers, the scalar optimizer that handles non-linear/embedding
805	    # params is configurable via ``config.muon_scalar_optimizer`` (e.g., 'adam' or 'lion');
806	    # deep-copy the registry defaults before rewriting so we never mutate shared state.
807	    default_param_overrides = copy.deepcopy(_EMERGING_OPTIMIZERS[eopt_name].default_param_overrides)
808	    if eopt_name in ('muon', 'adaptive_muon'):
809	        for override in default_param_overrides.values():
810	            if override.get('optimizer') in ('adam', 'lion'):
811	                override['optimizer'] = config.muon_scalar_optimizer
812	    config_overrides.update(default_param_overrides)
813	
814	    # Build param groups and bucket by (optimizer_name, is_expert_parallel).
815	    # Layer-wise distributed optimizer handles expert params internally so we skip that split.
816	    all_param_groups = _get_param_groups(model_chunks, config, config_overrides)
817	    grouped_param_groups = defaultdict(list)
818	    for group in all_param_groups:
819	        opt_name = group.get('optimizer', eopt_name)
820	        is_expert = group['is_expert_parallel'] and not use_layer_wise
821	        grouped_param_groups[(opt_name, is_expert)].append(group)
822	
823	    # Set up DistOpt process groups + filtered buffers once, only if we'll
824	    # construct a DistributedOptimizer for non-Muon groups in layer-wise mode.
825	    # The DistOpt-vs-LayerWise buffer split only happens when DDP was wrapped
826	    # with ``use_distributed_optimizer=True`` (i.e. the layout-based path); in
827	    # legacy ping-pong mode all params share one unpadded DDP buffer that
828	    # DistOpt cannot manage, so we keep non-Muon params inside LayerWise.
829	    ddp_uses_distributed_optimizer = (
830	        bool(getattr(model_chunks[0], 'ddp_config', None))
831	        and model_chunks[0].ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer
832	    )
833	    distopt_process_groups = None
834	    distopt_per_model_buffers = None
835	    use_separate_distributed_optimizer = ddp_uses_distributed_optimizer and use_layer_wise
836	    if use_separate_distributed_optimizer:
837	        ddp_config = model_chunks[0].ddp_config
838	        assert ddp_config.num_distributed_optimizer_instances == 1, (
839	            "Layer-wise + DistributedOptimizer split path does not yet support "
840	            "num_distributed_optimizer_instances > 1: distributed_optimizer_instance_id "
841	            "is hardcoded to 0 in this path. Disable use_layer_wise_param_layout to "
842	            "fall back to the legacy LayerWise ping-pong path."
843	        )
844	    if use_separate_distributed_optimizer and any(
845	        # A separate DistributedOptimizer with byte-level sharding handles any group
846	        # whose optimizer is not the primary emerging optimizer (stored in ``eopt_name``,
847	        # e.g., Muon). This includes scalar optimizers like Adam or Lion.
848	        not (opt_name == eopt_name and opt_name in _EMERGING_OPTIMIZERS)
849	        for (opt_name, _), groups in grouped_param_groups.items()
850	        if groups
851	    ):
852	        # ``setup_process_groups_for_optimizer`` rejects Gloo groups whenever
853	        # an explicit ``pg_collection`` is supplied, so the only legal value
854	        # here is False.
855	        distopt_process_groups = ProcessGroupCollection.setup_process_groups_for_optimizer(
856	            pg_collection, model_chunks, use_gloo_process_groups=False
857	        )
858	        # DistOpt should only manage non-LayerWise buffers (those holding
859	        # embeddings, biases, layernorm, etc.). Filter out the LayerWise
860	        # shard-aligned buffers that the LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer owns.
861	        distopt_per_model_buffers = {}
862	        for model_chunk_idx, model_chunk in enumerate(model_chunks):
863	            if not hasattr(model_chunk, 'buffers'):
864	                continue
865	            non_layer_wise_buffers = [
866	                buffer
867	                for buffer in model_chunk.buffers
868	                if buffer.params
869	                and not getattr(buffer.params[0], 'is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer', False)
870	            ]
871	            if non_layer_wise_buffers:
872	                distopt_per_model_buffers[model_chunk_idx] = non_layer_wise_buffers
873	
874	    # Build an optimizer for each (optimizer_name, is_expert) bucket and combine.
875	    # In layer-wise mode, emerging-optimizer (Muon) groups feed into LayerWise,
876	    # while non-emerging (Adam) groups are managed by a separate DistributedOptimizer
877	    # — that is, the LayerWise optimizer only owns Muon-managed matrix parameters,
878	    # and the rest go through DistOpt's standard byte-level shard machinery.
879	    results = []
880	    layer_wise_base_results = []  # (raw_optimizer, init_state_fn) feeding LayerWise.
881	    for (opt_name, is_expert), groups in grouped_param_groups.items():
882	        if not groups:
883	            continue
884	
885	        model_parallel_group = pg_collection.tp_ep_pp if is_expert else pg_collection.mp
886	
887	        # Only the primary emerging optimizer (stored in ``eopt_name``, e.g., Muon) is
888	        # constructed via ``_create_emerging_optimizer``. Scalar optimizers that also appear
889	        # in ``_EMERGING_OPTIMIZERS`` (e.g., Lion) fall through to the standard fallback path.
890	        if opt_name == eopt_name and opt_name in _EMERGING_OPTIMIZERS:
891	            optimizer, init_state_fn = _create_emerging_optimizer(
892	                config, groups, eopt_name, model_chunks, pg_collection
893	            )
894	            if use_layer_wise:
895	                layer_wise_base_results.append((optimizer, init_state_fn))
896	                continue
897	            if config.bf16:
898	                optimizer = Float16OptimizerWithFloat16Params(
899	                    optimizer, config, None, init_state_fn
900	                )
901	            else:
902	                optimizer = FP32Optimizer(optimizer, config, init_state_fn)
903	            setattr(optimizer, 'grad_stats_parallel_group', model_parallel_group)
904	            tp_group = pg_collection.tp
905	            expert_tp_group = getattr(pg_collection, 'expt_tp', tp_group)
906	            setattr(optimizer, 'tp_group', tp_group)
907	            setattr(optimizer, 'expert_tp_group', expert_tp_group)
908	            results.append(optimizer)
909	            continue
910	        else:
911	            fallback_config = copy.copy(config)
912	            fallback_config.optimizer = opt_name
913	            if use_separate_distributed_optimizer:
914	                # Route non-emerging params (adam/lion) through a real DistributedOptimizer
915	                # (byte-level sharding) instead of stuffing them inside LayerWise.
916	                for group in groups:
917	                    assert not group['is_expert_parallel'], (
918	                        "Non-emerging expert-parallel param groups are not yet "
919	                        "supported on the layer-wise + DistributedOptimizer "
920	                        "path: they need a separate DistOpt instance with the "
921	                        "expert-DP process group, which is not wired up yet. "
922	                        "Disable use_layer_wise_param_layout to fall back to "
923	                        "the legacy LayerWise ping-pong path for MoE models."
924	                    )
925	                fallback_config.use_distributed_optimizer = True
926	                result = _get_megatron_optimizer_based_on_param_groups(
927	                    config=fallback_config,
928	                    model_chunks=model_chunks,
929	                    param_groups=groups,
930	                    per_model_buffers=distopt_per_model_buffers,
931	                    model_parallel_group=distopt_process_groups['mp_group'],
932	                    data_parallel_group=distopt_process_groups['intra_dp_cp_group'],
933	                    data_parallel_group_gloo=distopt_process_groups['intra_dp_cp_group_gloo'],
934	                    data_parallel_group_idx=get_pg_rank(distopt_process_groups['mp_group']),
935	                    intra_dist_opt_group=distopt_process_groups['intra_dist_opt_group'],
936	                    distributed_optimizer_instance_id=0,
937	                    pg_collection=pg_collection,
938	                    skip_megatron_wrapping=False,
939	                )
940	                # TODO(deyuf): ChainedOptimizer currently asserts all sub-optimizers
941	                # share the same config. Reset to the top-level config so the
942	                # assertion holds when DistOpt+LayerWise are chained.
943	                if hasattr(result, 'config'):
944	                    result.config = config
945	                results.append(result)
946	            else:
947	                # Legacy ping-pong layer-wise path (use_layer_wise=True) or the
948	                # non-layer-wise standard chain: keep ``use_distributed_optimizer``
949	                # off; in layer-wise mode the raw torch optimizer (returned as a
950	                # ``(optimizer, init_state_fn)`` tuple via ``skip_megatron_wrapping``)
951	                # feeds into ``LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer``.
952	                fallback_config.use_distributed_optimizer = False
953	                result = _get_megatron_optimizer_based_on_param_groups(
954	                    config=fallback_config,
955	                    model_chunks=model_chunks,
956	                    param_groups=groups,
957	                    model_parallel_group=model_parallel_group,
958	                    pg_collection=pg_collection,
959	                    skip_megatron_wrapping=use_layer_wise,
960	                )
961	                if use_layer_wise:
962	                    layer_wise_base_results.append(result)
963	                else:
964	                    if hasattr(result, 'config'):
965	                        result.config = config
966	                    results.append(result)
967	
968	    if use_layer_wise:
969	        log_single_rank(
970	            logger, logging.INFO, f'Using LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer for {eopt_name}'
971	        )
972	        base_optimizers, init_fns = (), ()
973	        if layer_wise_base_results:
974	            base_optimizers, init_fns = zip(*layer_wise_base_results)
975	        layer_wise_optimizer = LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer(
976	            list(base_optimizers),
977	            config,
978	            pg_collection,
979	            init_state_fn_list=list(init_fns),
980	            model_chunks=model_chunks,
981	        )
982	        # LayerWise owns Muon-managed params; DistOpt instances in ``results``
983	        # own the rest. Chain them so the training loop sees one optimizer.
984	        if results:
985	            return ChainedOptimizer([layer_wise_optimizer] + results)
986	        return layer_wise_optimizer
987	
988	    return ChainedOptimizer(results)

991	def get_megatron_optimizer(
992	    config: OptimizerConfig,
993	    model_chunks: List[MegatronModule],
994	    config_overrides: Optional[Dict[ParamKey, ParamGroupOverride]] = None,
995	    use_gloo_process_groups: bool = True,
996	    pg_collection: Optional[ProcessGroupCollection] = None,
997	    dump_param_to_param_group_map: Optional[str] = None,
998	) -> MegatronOptimizer:
999	    """Retrieve the Megatron optimizer for model chunks.

999	    """Retrieve the Megatron optimizer for model chunks.
1000	
1001	    Handles both standard optimizers (Adam, SGD) and emerging optimizers (e.g. Muon).
1002	    We use separate optimizers for expert parameters and non-expert parameters.
1003	    For emerging optimizers with ``config.use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True``,
1004	    the optimizer is automatically wrapped with :class:`LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer`.
1005	
1006	    Args:
1007	        config (OptimizerConfig): optimizer configuration object.
1008	        model_chunks (List[MegatronModule]): model chunks to get optimizer for.
1009	        config_overrides (Optional[Dict[ParamKey, OptimizerConfig]]): optional dictionary of
1010	            optimizer configuration objects to override default optimizer behavior for different
1011	            subsets of parameters (identified by ParamKey).
1012	        use_gloo_process_groups (bool): if false, disable use of Gloo process groups
1013	            in underlying Megatron optimizers.
1014	        pg_collection: Optional unified process group for distributed training.
1015	        dump_param_to_param_group_map (Optional[str]): path to dump parameter to param group map.
1016	
1017	    Returns:
1018	        Instance of MegatronOptimizer.
1019	    """
1020	
1021	    # A MimoModel routes to the heterogeneous per-module optimizer builder.
1022	    from megatron.core.models.mimo.model.base import MimoModel
1023	
1024	    if isinstance(model_chunks[0], MimoModel):
1025	        from megatron.core.models.mimo.optimizer import get_mimo_optimizer
1026	
1027	        assert (
1028	            len(model_chunks) == 1
1029	        ), "MimoModel does not support virtual pipeline parallelism (multiple model chunks)"
1030	        return get_mimo_optimizer(model_chunks[0], config)
1031	
1032	    # None → apply standard defaults. To extend defaults with custom overrides,
1033	    # start from get_standard_config_overrides(config) and merge yours in.
1034	    if config_overrides is None:
1035	        config_overrides = get_standard_config_overrides(config)
1036	
1037	    check_config_overrides_consistency(config, config_overrides)
1038	
1039	    is_mfsdp_v2 = isinstance(model_chunks[0], FullyShardedDataParallelV2)
1040	    # TODO: the standard and emerging optimizer paths handle pg_collection differently;
1041	    # unify them so both use a single pg_collection-based flow.
1042	    if config.optimizer not in ('adam', 'sgd'):
1043	        return _get_megatron_emerging_optimizer(
1044	            config=config,
1045	            model_chunks=model_chunks,
1046	            config_overrides=config_overrides,
1047	            pg_collection=pg_collection,
1048	        )
1049	
1050	    log_single_rank(logger, logging.INFO, f'Setting up optimizer with config {config}')
1051	
1052	    if is_mfsdp_v2:
1053	        if config.use_distributed_optimizer:
1054	            raise ValueError("MFSDP v2 currently requires use_distributed_optimizer=False.")
1055	
1056	    # Separate out first model chunk if overlapping param AG with optimizer step.
1057	    if config.overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step:
1058	        all_dense_model_chunks = [[model_chunks[0]], model_chunks[1:]]
1059	        overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step_flags = [True, False]
1060	    else:
1061	        all_dense_model_chunks = [model_chunks]
1062	        overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step_flags = [False]
1063	
1064	    # Setup process groups using helper method
1065	    process_groups_dict = ProcessGroupCollection.setup_process_groups_for_optimizer(
1066	        pg_collection, model_chunks, use_gloo_process_groups
1067	    )
1068	
1069	    dp_cp_group = process_groups_dict['dp_cp_group']
1070	    intra_dp_cp_group = process_groups_dict['intra_dp_cp_group']
1071	    intra_expt_dp_group = process_groups_dict['intra_expt_dp_group']
1072	    mp_group = process_groups_dict['mp_group']
1073	    expt_tp_pp_group = process_groups_dict['expt_tp_pp_group']
1074	    expt_tp_pp_with_egtp_remat_group = process_groups_dict['expt_tp_pp_with_egtp_remat_group']
1075	    intra_dp_cp_group_gloo = process_groups_dict['intra_dp_cp_group_gloo']
1076	    intra_expt_dp_group_gloo = process_groups_dict['intra_expt_dp_group_gloo']
1077	    intra_dist_opt_group = process_groups_dict['intra_dist_opt_group']
1078	
1079	    # ``mp_group`` spans TP×GTP_remat×PP (GTP_remat-merged).
1080	    model_parallel_rank = get_pg_rank(mp_group)
1081	
1082	    if get_pg_size(dp_cp_group) > get_pg_size(intra_dp_cp_group):
1083	        inter_dist_opt_group = process_groups_dict['inter_dist_opt_group']
1084	        distributed_optimizer_instance_id = get_pg_rank(inter_dist_opt_group)
1085	    else:
1086	        distributed_optimizer_instance_id = 0
1087	
1088	    optimizers = []
1089	    model_chunk_offset = 0
1090	    ddp_config = model_chunks[0].ddp_config  # Use the first model chunk's DDP config
1091	    if ddp_config.use_megatron_fsdp:
1092	        # For no_shard, gradients are replicated across DP ranks after all-reduce, so grad stats
1093	        # should only be reduced over TP/PP (model_parallel_group) to avoid inflating the norm.
1094	        effective_intra_dist_opt_group = (
1095	            mp_group
1096	            if ddp_config.data_parallel_sharding_strategy == 'no_shard'
1097	            else intra_dist_opt_group
1098	        )
1099	        for model_chunk, overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step in zip(
1100	            all_dense_model_chunks, overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step_flags
1101	        ):
1102	            if is_mfsdp_v2:
1103	                param_groups = _get_param_groups(model_chunk, config, config_overrides)
1104	                # TE FusedAdam can skip pending updates when a group ends in an empty tensor:
1105	                # https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/issues/3207.
1106	                # Empty local shards have no optimizer state or data to update, so omit them.
1107	                for param_group in param_groups:
1108	                    param_group['params'] = [

383	    def start_param_sync(self, force_sync: bool = False):
384	        """
385	        Initiates all necessary param all-gathers for this bucket.
386	
387	        When ddp_config.overlap_param_gather is set to True, dispatches an asynchronous
388	        communication call (unless force_sync is True). When ddp_config.overlap_param_gather
389	        is set to False, makes synchronous call.
390	
391	        Args:
392	            force_sync (bool, optional): force synchronous collective regardless of
393	                other settings if true.
394	        """
395	        # overlap_param_gather covers the layer-wise optimizer case, which sets
396	        # overlap_param_gather=True without use_distributed_optimizer.
397	        assert self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer or self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather
398	
399	        if force_sync:
400	            if self.param_gather_handle is not None:
401	                self.param_gather_handle.wait()
402	                self.param_gather_handle = None
403	                self._post_param_sync()
404	                return
405	        else:
406	            assert self.param_gather_handle is None
407	
408	        async_op = self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather and not force_sync
409	
410	        if not self.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer:
411	            # Legacy layer-wise optimizer path: use all_gather for variable-size
412	            # param gather.  Once all layerwise call sites set
413	            # ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer=True, this branch can be removed.
414	            #
415	            # Each rank may own a different number of params per bucket, so
416	            # layerwise_param_flat_sizes can vary across ranks.  PyTorch's NCCL
417	            # backend handles uneven tensor sizes in torch.distributed.all_gather
418	            # (falling back to grouped send/recv internally when sizes differ),
419	            # so no manual padding is needed.
420	            dp_size = self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_size
421	            if dp_size == 1:
422	                # Single-rank group (e.g., expt_dp_size == 1): no all-gather needed.
423	                if force_sync and self.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather:
424	                    self._post_param_sync()
425	                self.param_gather_dispatched = True
426	                return
427	            local_rank = self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_rank
428	            group = self.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_group
429	            layerwise_work_handles = []
430	            for bucket in self.buckets:
431	                # Use param dtype (e.g., bf16), NOT grad dtype (which may be
432	                # fp32 when grad_reduce_in_fp32 is enabled).
433	                param_dtype = bucket.params_list[0].dtype
434	
435	                if max(bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes) == 0:
436	                    bucket.layerwise_gather_list = None
437	                    continue
438	
439	                local_size = bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes[local_rank]
440	                total_gather_size = sum(bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes)
441	
442	                # Reuse grad_data as the all_gather receive buffer; it is idle
443	                # during forward and grad_dtype.element_size >= param_dtype.
444	                reuse_buf = bucket.grad_data.view(param_dtype)
445	                assert reuse_buf.numel() >= total_gather_size
446	
447	                # Partition reuse_buf into contiguous per-rank receive slices.
448	                gather_list = []
449	                offset = 0
450	                for i in range(dp_size):
451	                    size = bucket.layerwise_param_flat_sizes[i]
452	                    gather_list.append(reuse_buf[offset : offset + size])
453	                    offset += size

469	                                "master) to stage the all-gather source; got None."

472	                        else:
